build.notes: Make-only build with no configure step, compiled out of tree with 'make -f ../Makefile VPATH=..'. Two source patches (Makefile.diff, krep.diff) remove host-vector and thread-pool behaviour and run partitions sequentially. They are third-party build inputs kept in environment/third_party/concollmic with their licences; environment/README.md names the files and their pinned SHA-256 values. The patched Makefile appends -O1 after the -O0 of the environment.
